sentences.text:
Author: J. Uma Devi
Bench: J. Uma Devi
 1
 The Hon'Ble Ms. Justice J. Uma Devi
 Criminal Petition No.524 of 2020
Order:

This Criminal Petition is filed by the petitioner/Accused, under Section 482 of Criminal Procedure Code,1973 (for short 'Cr.P.C'), seeking to quash the proceedings in Crime No.168 of 2019 of Eluru Town police station, West Godavari District, registered for the offences punishable under Sections 328, 270, 273 of Indian Penal Code, 1860 (for short 'I.P.C') and Section 22 of The Cigarettes and Other Products (Prohibition of Advertisement and Regulation of Trade and Commerce, Production,
Supply and Distribution) Act, 2003 (for short 'COTPA Act').
When the matter is taken up for hearing, it is brought to the notice of this Court that in batch of Criminal Petitions, filed to quash the proceedings registered for the offences under Indian Penal Code and Food Safety and Standards Act,2006, are allowed by this Court, vide Order, dated 27.08.2018 in Criminal Petition No.3731 of 2018 and batch.

entities.text: Eluru Town police station, West Godavari District
entities.label: ORG

entities.text:
Cigarettes and Other Products (Prohibition of Advertisement and Regulation of Trade and Commerce, Production,
Supply and Distribution) Act, 2003
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: The case on hand has also been filed questioning the proceedings in F.I.R registered for the offence of possessing Gutka packets.

Following the order passed in the aforementioned batch of Criminal Petitions, and for the reasons recorded therein, this Criminal Petition is allowed, quashing the proceedings in Crime No.168 of 2019 of Eluru Town police station, West Godavari registered for the offences punishable under Sections 328, 270, 273 of I.P.C and Section 22 of the COTPA Act as against the petitioner.

entities.text: Eluru Town police station, West Godavari
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text:
Consequently, miscellaneous petitions pending, if any, in the Criminal Petition shall stand closed.
_______________________ JUSTICE J. UMA DEVI 31.01.2020 MP Maajeti Mohini Lakshmi vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh on 31 January, 2020 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/93102938/
